info.title: API.SH: OnTheMarket
info.description: The OnTheMarket API from API.SH: public OnTheMarket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An estate agent branch on OnTheMarket: branch id, name, phone, address, postcode, coordinates, logo, description, sales and lettings, affiliations (ARLA, NAEA...), social links, opening hours, testimonials, team size, and its listings for sale or to rent with paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onthemarket-agent

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The branch's onthemarket.com/agents/branch/ link or its name part (agent.url of a listing).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Listings for sale or to rent.

get.description:
One OnTheMarket property: title, type, price and qualifier, labels (reduced, chain-free...), added or reduced, views, bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area, address, postcode, coordinates, description, key information (tenure, ground rent, service charge, council tax...), EPC rating, area statistics, mobile reception, photos, floor plans, virtual tours, videos, documents, nearby stations and schools, similar sold properties nearby, and the estate agent (branch id, name, phone, address, logo, page, description). Give `id`, an onthemarket.com/details/ link as `url`, or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onthemarket-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: OnTheMarket listing id (id of a search result).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current result.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Sold house prices on OnTheMarket by place: for a town or region the average sold price, its change over the year and the date of the data, with the areas and postcode districts below it; for a postcode district its streets; for a street every sold home with each sale's price and date, property type, tenure and coordinates. Streets are paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onthemarket-property-prices

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A town, region, postcode district or street as OnTheMarket writes it (e.g. oxford, ox1, abingdon-road-oxford-ox1; the areas, postcode_districts and streets in an answer give more), or an onthemarket.com/uk-house-prices/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes for sale and to rent in the UK on OnTheMarket with the site's filters: place (town, region or postcode district), property type, price, bedrooms, radius, keywords, date added, under offer or let agreed, new homes, auction, retirement, shared ownership, student, pets, furnishing, let length, greener choice, accessible and character properties, plus sort. Each result has id, link, title, property type, price and qualifier, bedrooms, bathrooms, address, coordinates, key features, labels (reduced, new), photos and the estate agent (id, name, phone, logo, page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onthemarket-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place: a town, county, region or postcode district (london, manchester, n11, south-east-london), or an onthemarket.com search link.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price (GBP; per month when renting).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price (GBP; per month when renting).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius around the place, in miles (0.25 to 40).

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words in the listing, comma list (garden, garage...).

parameters.name: include_under_offer
parameters.description: Include properties under offer or sold STC.

parameters.name: new_homes
parameters.description: New homes: include (default), only or exclude.

parameters.name: retirement
parameters.description: true: retirement homes only; false: leave them out.

parameters.name: shared_ownership
parameters.description: true: shared ownership only; false: leave it out.

parameters.name: greener_choice
parameters.description: Greener homes only (EPC A-C, heat pumps, solar...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
